artifact_selection.reason: Reusable task-scoped derived context and reference workflows; no always-on service or new agent authority.

alternative_rejected: A second workflow engine or a global canonical memory store.
baseline: without-skill CLI unavailable; frozen deterministic seed demonstrated missing implementation before authoring it.
dependency_model: Python standard library; no peer runtime imports

reproducibility.mechanical: Canonical JSON, source hashes, exact fields, bounded paths/locks, immutable objects and frozen seed.
reproducibility.heuristic: Declared reference ordering and conservative delegation margin.
reproducibility.judgment: Owner selection, true relevance, hermeticity completeness, authorization and canonical gate acceptance remain with owner.
reproducibility.external: Provider usage/model outcomes/host capabilities unavailable unless explicitly supplied; null/not-run.

protected: Original source ZIP, baseline, frozen seed evaluator expectations, unrelated skills and canonical domain contracts.
reasons: No paid/native model sessions; local CLI/behavior checks are separate evidence.
